title: Auto-ping now works the map when you have no target
body: With a target selected nothing changes: auto-ping pings that target. With no target selected it now also pings the repeaters around you, a few per round, taking turns so everything in earshot gets asked. Each ping makes that repeater transmit once, and that transmission is another measurement on your map. A repeater that stays silent is asked less often until you hear it again.
